patterns.note: Alternating full-width background sections (light beige and dark brown) are used to clearly delineate major content blocks and create visual rhythm down the page.
Content is frequently presented in card-like structures with subtle corner radii and shadows, especially for feature explanations and data points, enhancing readability and visual separation.
A vibrant orange is consistently used as the primary accent color for all calls-to-action, key highlights, and interactive elements, standing out against the neutral background palette.
Large, bold, sans-serif headings introduce each major section, establishing a strong visual hierarchy and guiding the user through the page's narrative.
Content sections and individual elements reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in and slight upward slide animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling.

technique_notes: The site employs a transforming sticky header: initially transparent over the hero, it transitions to a solid white background with a subtle drop shadow and becomes fixed at the top of the viewport after the user scrolls past the initial hero section.

Sections and key content blocks are animated into view using a scroll-triggered effect, typically a gentle fade-in combined with a slight upward translation, creating a dynamic reveal as the user scrolls down the page.
A subtle diagonal line pattern is used as a background texture in the hero and other light-colored sections, adding visual depth and brand personality without distracting from the primary content.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~4-5x body for H1, ~2-3x body for H2) create strong hierarchy, complemented by legible body text and small uppercase labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (e.g., buttons, cards have a small, consistent corner radius).
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced, with an airy hero section and clear, consistent vertical spacing between content blocks and within card layouts.

standout: This site's design stands out by immediately presenting a detailed 'Before & After' comparison with data-rich mockups in the hero section, effectively demonstrating value and building trust upfront. The bold use of a vibrant orange against a sophisticated dark brown and light beige palette creates a distinctive and impactful brand presence.
